Done. Summary of what happened and what I did:

**Issue:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate, following the latest deploy.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rollback:** Rolled back all production regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt partially failed (only us-east completed before an orchestrator error), so I retried and completed the remaining regions.
2. **Verified:** Post-rollback, all three regions are on v2.3.0, healthy, with the error rate back down to ~0.2%.
3. **Incident:** Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api rolled back from unhealthy v2.3.1 to v2.3.0"), which has paged the on-call engineer. The incident describes the v2.3.1 failure, the rollback, and notes follow-up to investigate the root cause of v2.3.1 before re-attempting that release.
